target.statement: PocketSR achieves LPIPS 0.2713 on the RealSR benchmark, outperforming AdcSR (0.2885) and OSEDiff (0.2921).

compute.basis: The target requires reproducing a trained 146M-parameter one-step diffusion SR model (168k training steps at batch 64 on 512px images) plus RealSR evaluation, and no PocketSR code or weights are released, making a CPU-only laptop run effectively infeasible.

blockers: No official PocketSR code or pretrained weights are released
Requires training a diffusion U-Net for 168,000 steps at batch size 64
Training needs GPU(s); CPU-only laptop is impractical
Training data (LSDIR ~500K images + FFHQ 10K) requires large download/disk
Architecture and pruning details are incomplete for exact reimplementation
title: PocketSR: The Super-Resolution Expert in Your Pocket Mobiles
